summary: Meta Platforms filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an ordinary investment-grade debt offering: €9.0B across six senior unsecured note series (€1.75B 4.300% 2031, €1.25B 4.650% 2033, €1.0B 4.900% 2035, €1.75B 5.400% 2038, €1.75B 6.050% 2044, €1.5B 6.400% 2065). Public offering prices range 99.446–99.988, underwriting discount 0.100–0.400%, net proceeds ~€8.964B before expenses; settlement expected November 12, 2026, with interest from that date. Notes rank equally with unsecured senior indebtedness, are redeemable at Meta's option, and are intended for Nasdaq Bond Exchange listing. Bookrunners: Citigroup, Morgan Stanley; passive joint bookrunners Goldman Sachs, BofA, J.P. Morgan; co-manager Société Générale. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; no deal-arb angle, watch investment-grade spreads and use of proceeds.
